Application Data.NAME: Pixel Perfect Photography Supply
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Pixel Perfect Photography Supply specializes in providing high-quality camera equipment, accessories, and photo supplies to amateur and professional photographers. Our retail store offers a wide range of products including cameras, lenses, tripods, lighting equipment, and photo printing services. We prioritize customer satisfaction through knowledgeable staff and personalized service. Additionally, we maintain a secure environment with surveillance systems in place to protect our high-value inventory.
